limitations: The 46 dossiers are a historically distributed selection, not a complete catalogue of every spacecraft and launch vehicle.
Every model is a normalized functional schematic; generated geometry does not establish real internal packaging, engineering dimensions, mass properties, aerodynamics or manufacturing details.
Articles and vendor cases were checked against linked primary sources; automated URL checks validate structure, not the enduring availability or truth of every external claim.
No automatic news ingestion, backend CMS or remote engineering solver is included.
AerospaceSimUE remains untouched; prior source audit is not a new execution of its full simulation.
